data.exact_reserve_text: Prior year reserve releases in 2015 were GBP 29.8m (2014 GBP 22.9m).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 33.0m, representing 9.03% of its opening gross reserves. This figure is derived from the gross claims development triangle. This contrasts with the narrative in the Strategic Report which stated net prior year reserve releases of GBP 29.8m, attributed to an absence of major catastrophe losses and favourable development of prior year reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable development of prior year reserves

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: There is a significant discrepancy between the narrative statement of 'Prior year reserve releases in 2015 were GBP 29.8m' (page 1) and the calculated gross prior year development of +33.0m (strengthening) from the claims development triangle (page 14). The narrative figure is likely net of reinsurance, while the triangle provides a gross figure. Following the rule to prioritize gross triangle over net narrative, the gross strengthening is used. The causes mentioned in the narrative (absence of major catastrophe losses, favourable development) are for the net release, not the gross strengthening, so 'Other' is used for primary_causes.
